messages.subject: Investigating whether effects of a procrustes ANOVA (ind,side,ind*side) differ by group
parts:
Hi all, 

I can run a Procrustes ANOVA on my data (faces) using the bilat.symmetry() function to get effects of ind, side and ind*side, which is great, but i also have a factor (method 1 vs method 2) and i'd like to see how it interacts with these factors. I'd like to see how the effects of ind, side and ind*side differ between methods. I have faces of the same people for both methods. I don't seem to be able to do with with the bilat.symmetry function. Does anyone know if what i'm asking for is possible 

Cheers,

Richie
